# Exsurge

`exsurge.min.js` is the offline SVG chant renderer from
https://github.com/bbloomf/jgabc at commit
`16a254bb3c1bccdf653943692902c0478177a96b`.

Source: https://github.com/bbloomf/exsurge (MIT; see exsurge.LICENSE).
The bundle contains its square-notation glyph outlines. ChantEdit supplies
text measurement through Pango and executes the bundle in QuickJS, without
a browser, DOM, Node runtime, web server, or external font downloads.
